info.name: List governance items for an account

items.docs:
Returns paginated referendum or democracy items associated with the specified account.
This API only supports networks with democracy frame

Returns a paginated child-bounty list, optionally filtered by parent bounty ID.

items.docs: Returns external governance posts and comments for the specified item. This endpoint is powered by Subsquare.
